name: Comms by Osis
tagline: Give AI agents iMessage, RCS, and SMS for sales and customer conversations.
description: Connect to your Comms workspace to read conversations, draft replies, and send iMessage, RCS, or SMS when requested. Use it for sales follow-up, appointment confirmations, and customer replies. This entry uses the focused inbox endpoint with eight read/send tools. A Comms account and OAuth authorization are required. Sending depends on a connected line, channel availability, workspace entitlements, and granted permissions. Confirm the recipient, sending line, and exact text before sending. Message submission is not proof of recipient delivery.

install.notes: Sign in to Comms in the OAuth window and select the workspace and scopes you intend to authorize. No API key is bundled. Review support, privacy, and terms at https://comms.osis.co/contact, https://comms.osis.co/privacy, and https://comms.osis.co/terms.
